images/000000478717.jpg: The parrot is leaning over a book. Between the chair, the branches and the reflections, there's a lot competing for attention.
images/000000137788.jpg: The dog lies still behind a half-open door. The clutter of little objects on the shelves makes the scene feel rather unappealing.
images/000000020371.jpg: I like the way the soft, subdued background leaves the resting pigeon almost alone on the ledge. It's a beautiful little portrait.
images/000000231022.jpg: The cat rests almost motionless in shadow, a pale face set apart from its dark surroundings.
images/000000068293.jpg: The little bird's brilliant green feathers and red throat stand out against that soft backdrop. I really like the color here.
images/000000196355.jpg: The riders sit still on their horses; the black-and-white photograph has a quiet, formal air.
images/000000480205.jpg: I like the elegant line of the bird's neck as it stands still at the water's edge.
images/000000066652.jpg: The giraffe stands quietly with its head above the foliage. I like how its shape emerges from those subdued colors.
images/000000516328.jpg: The bright blue hydrant behind the bird makes an amusing splash of color in the grass.
images/000000177529.jpg: It's sweet and funny how the tiny kitten and the much larger dog lean in nose to nose.
images/000000557329.jpg: The little bird sits still among overlapping leaves and twigs; it takes a moment to pick it out.
images/000000132760.jpg: Several figures and animals share the lawn, with still more detail behind them. My eye keeps moving around the frame.
images/000000221542.jpg: That close, head-on view of the emu feels a little intimidating despite the subdued colors.
images/000000493438.jpg: The zebras look peaceful under the trees. I like the appealing sight of the smaller animal resting nearby.
images/000000438107.jpg: The sweep of the swan's neck is beautiful, but that close view of its bill feels a bit threatening too.
images/000000022894.jpg: The dog looks endearing and thoroughly unthreatening as it waits in the grass beside the disc. I like this one.
